_note: SYNTHETIC, not a capture. No diagnostics dump in this project or in the Home Assistant integration has ever recorded a battery generating PV, so this frame is hand built to the shape the closest real capture showed: an AFERIY PS240 reporting SSumInfoList.TotalPVPower 758 while every Storage_list entry reported PvChargingPower 0 and Pv1Power..Pv4Power 0. That combination is the reason the solar device reads the summary field only: a fallback to the per-unit PvChargingPower would report this generating array as producing nothing. Only last_poll is defined here; tests compose it onto the registers of jet-single-unit.json, so the control register set stays single sourced and cannot drift from the real one. Replace this file with a real capture once one exists.
